profile.headline: Dedicated software engineer - I help build and maintain software with Javascript, C#, React, .NET, and Azure
profile.summary:
Engineering web apps using React, JavaScript, .NET and C#. Love solving the challenges of making software, although you might sometimes find me quietly cursing at a red screen on my ginormous monitor. I am experienced with troubleshooting and debugging software that uses C#, javascript, SQL, NoSQL.

I view myself as a challenger tackling all new problems that come my way. I am always trying to improve my code and my methods. I don't always succeed, but I always learn something new along the way. I try to balance the technical, social, and economic aspects of engineering, but I usually fall on the technical side.

I am interested in software engineering and development, electrical engineering, computer vision, cell phones, computers. I like Android, Apple, Windows, Linux, Chrome, Firefox and I sometimes dislike them too (especially when one is missing a feature I like in the other.)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on updating and testing their .NET web API using .NET core and entity framework core.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Azure Key Vault · Entity Framework (EF) Core · C#

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a software engineer on a new feature for Avigilon Cloud Services. The project used React, Typescript, and JavaScript for the front-end and .NET, C#, Entity Framework, and Postgres SQL for the backend. We were using Playwright for UI/integration tests and Jest and XUnit for unit tests. The service was deployed to Azure and connected to other services using Azure Service Bus.

Previously worked on creating a React maps component for the creation, editing, and monitoring of security surveillance systems. The maps component used Mapbox and ESRI for map providers  and included the ability to create indoor maps to place cameras and other objects. I integrated the new component into the System Design Tool (SDT). The components in the map component were built using Storybook to minimize coupling and tested with jest and cypress.
positions.insights: Skills: React · npm · Yarn · JavaScript · Git · OData · Azure DevOps · Redux.js · Node.js · Jest · HTML · Functional Programming · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a Full Stack Developer improving their CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) platform. The front-end uses React, React Native, Redux, and Apollo Client. The backend API uses GraphQL and MongoDb as the database.
positions.insights: Skills: React · npm · Yarn · JavaScript · Git · HTML · Functional Programming · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, deployed, and maintained multiple apps and legacy code.

Developed and released the Better Human App to the App Store and Google play store. The Better Human App is a food, macro and exercise logger. The Better Human App was built with React, React Native, and Firebase.

Developed Auto Recon which is a system to assist dealerships with the reconditioning process. This app was also built using React, React-Native, and Firebase.

Worked on version 2 of the Better Human App that will add much asked for features from our business partners. Version 2 will integrate with a web dashboard based on React and Redux.

I also squashed bugs and maintained the company's older software based on  C# and .NET, and managed the VPS server and the MySQL database.
positions.insights: Skills: React · npm · Yarn · JavaScript · Git · HTML · Functional Programming · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Field Service Technician
positions.description:
Reduced costs and increased efficiency by developing an android app to keep track of truck inventory.

Drove around the DFW Metroplex fixing vehicle inspection machines at customer sites. Fixed all kind of problems including mechanical problems, electrical problems, software problems and even user error.

positions.title: Service Department Supervisor
positions.description: Fixed all kinds of computers with all kinds of problems.
